title: arum orientale subsp. besserianum
intro: Arum orientale subsp. besserianum, commonly known as Bessarion's arum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Arum. It is a bulbous perennial that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Bessarion's arum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and boost the immune system due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
